analyst_view.overall: Union Saint-Gilloise are 4th in the Europa League with 10 points and top of the Belgian league after a 1-0 win at Kortrijk; they play this home game at Den Dreef in Leuven, which they are not expected to fill. Lech Poznan lead the Polish league but have only 1 point in Europe, and Niels Frederiksen wants a win here or against Ferencvaros; the squad flies in on Wednesday morning and home straight after the match. Lech are without captain and striker Mikael Ishak (hamstring, out until the winter break), Walemark, Moutinho, Gholizadeh and Douglas, all already in the numbers, and Daniel Håkans felt knee discomfort before Sunday's game but was expected to train. Union miss captain Kevin Mac Allister long-term, Biondic's knock is counted, and Massiré Sylla's absence at Kortrijk is still unexplained. Spanish referee José María Sánchez Martínez is now named and his card record is already counted; no fresh team news points either way, so I keep the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals, 2.6 for Union, with Biondic's absence already taken off. Lech have been without Ishak since late October, so their recent scoring already reflects that, and Håkans should be fit; Sylla's possible absence at the back for Union is small and unconfirmed, so I stay at about 3.4.

corners.text: The numbers expect 8.2 corners, already trimming Union for their low recent corner count. Lech are short of wingers with Walemark out and Håkans only just recovering, but their side is already small (3.1), so I stay at about 8.2.

cards.text: The numbers now say 4.2 cards, adding about 18% for referee Sánchez Martínez's record and lowering for both sides' calm recent games. Lech need points but are a passing side rather than a rough one, Union play a controlled game, and a half-empty Den Dreef adds little heat, so I stay at about 4.2.

shots.text: The numbers expect 30.8 shots, with Union expected to dominate (21.3). Both clubs play league games three days later, but Frederiksen needs points and Union keep a settled side, so the open game the numbers assume still fits and I stay at about 31.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.6 shots on target, already adding for Union's accurate recent shooting. Union hit the woodwork and had chances at Kortrijk, and Lech's attack without Ishak is what their recent games already show, so I stay at about 11.6.
